newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH SPT SHARES FALL ON PROFIT TAKING - DEALERS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH SPT SHARES FALL ON PROFIT TAKING - DEALERS.

text.p: Shares in Czech SPT Telecom a.s., the most heavily capitalised issue on the Prague bourse, fell back on Wednesday on profit taking after gaining more than 10 percent in just two days, dealers said.
SPT was down 31 crowns to 3,100 at 1100 GMT during the continuous trading session on the bourse.

"I think it is simply that the market was overbought during the last couple of days...it was probably profit taking and also demand was down compared to the last two days," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostneska Banka.
SPT rose by the maximum daily allowable eight percent on Tuesday and a further 2.9 percent at Wednesday's fixing.
Dealers said the surge was due to a central bank decision to allow the crown to float downwards after coming under sustained attack from foreign speculators.
The crown lost over eight percent against the mark to around 19.5.
